title: Remove the validating phase from the enum and retarget both hardcoded guards
action: Per D3, drop 'validating' from PHASES at lib/state.mjs:41-51 (KNOWN_PHASES derives unchanged). Set GATED_PHASES at lib/guards.mjs:142 to new Set(['exploring','planning']). Set PHASE_GATE at hooks/bee-session-close.mjs:26 to Object.freeze({ planning: 'execution' }) -- the value moves from 'shape' to 'execution' because every other enforcement surface for phase planning already reads execution (guards.mjs:1307-1308) and D15 keeps the two flipped in lockstep. The merged gate is carried by phase 'planning'; see plan.md Q1 for why no new phase is introduced. Each packages/bee file and its .bee/bin twin move in the SAME commit -- a one-sided edit fails test_misc.mjs:1881. Do not touch isDebtGuardedDeparture (state.mjs:2762-2764): it is derived from targetPhase !== fromPhase and already covers planning -> swarming. ALSO FIX YOUR OWN VERIFY (advisor finding 4): packages/bee/tests/test_cli_state.mjs is this cell's verify command and hand-writes phase 'validating' at :315,736,777,803,835,864, driving state set --owner validating into the bee.mjs:2931 refusal -- so this cell's verify is guaranteed red at its own boundary unless you migrate those six sites to 'planning' in THIS cell. Do not defer them to vd-4.

truths: PHASE_GATE maps planning to 'execution' and has no validating entry
Each of the three packages/bee files is byte-identical to its .bee/bin twin
node packages/bee/tests/test_cli_state.mjs exits 0 with no hand-written 'validating' phase left in it
key_links: the three .bee/bin twins change in the same commit
prohibitions: No new phase value added to the enum
No change to TERMINAL_PHASES or SCRIBING_RUN_FROM
No weakening a test_cli_state.mjs assertion to dodge the migration

verify: node packages/bee/tests/test_misc.mjs && node packages/bee/tests/test_cli_state.mjs && node packages/bee/tests/test_state.mjs && node packages/bee/tests/test_guards.mjs

trace.outcome: Dropped 'validating' from PHASES, narrowed GATED_PHASES to {exploring,planning}, and PHASE_GATE to {planning: execution} across all 3 packages/bee files + .bee/bin twins (byte-identical); migrated 7 hand-written 'validating' phase sites in test_cli_state.mjs and 1 stale GATED_PHASES fixture in test_guards.mjs off the retired phase.

deviations.summary: Migrated a 7th hand-written 'validating' phase site in test_cli_state.mjs (the p2-1 departure-guard test at the old line 3417, target `--phase validating`) that the advisor's six named sites did not cover — found via a full grep of the file, not by the cell's action text. Retargeted to `--phase swarming` (the test's intent is 'debt-guard fires on every departure from planning', not specifically on 'validating' as the target) and updated the assertion message to match.

Edited packages/bee/tests/test_guards.mjs (not in this cell's declared `files`) to migrate NET branch 6's loop fixture off the retired 3-member GATED_PHASES set (['exploring','planning','validating']) to the real 2-member set, and updated the test title to match. This was explicitly anticipated by the dispatch prompt ('Expect test_guards.mjs to have opinions about GATED_PHASES ... A fixture pinning the retired set is yours to migrate') and reserved before writing; a real behavior regression there would instead have been a stop-and-report.

Updated three stale comments directly adjacent to the touched constants (guards.mjs:1021 docstring listing gated phases; bee-session-close.mjs's PHASE_GATE header comment and the maybeBypassBlock comment enumerating phase set members) so the prose stays accurate to the new two-member GATED_PHASES / single-key PHASE_GATE. No logic changed.
